infoLinks.urlText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
infoLinks.content:
John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harris St and the Light Rail stop towards Dulwich Hill is temporarily out of service.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
  • Use the stairs
  • Or use the lift on the opposite platform
For urgent assistance:
  • Use the Help Point if on the platform
  • Or call 131 500

infoLinks.urlText: Major Event Buses operating for the NRL & NRLW Grand Final at Sydney Olympic Park
infoLinks.content:
• Sydney Olympic Park Major Event Buses will run for the NRL & NRLW Grand Final at Accor Stadium on Sunday 4 October.
  • Travel on Major Event Buses is included in the cost of your event ticket. Attendees do not need to tap on and off, simply show your match ticket to the driver when boarding buses.
  • Buses run frequently. Visit the NRL & NRLW Grand Final event page for more details.
